metadata.title: Proxy Society doctoral funding and recruitment route screen
metadata.status: Research only; no outreach, applications or form submissions performed
metadata.method: Primary university, lab and funding-agency pages. Dated calls, standing programmes and historical deadlines are separated. Scoped screen, not an exhaustive global vacancy audit.
metadata.fit_assessment: Fit and priorities are research judgments, not endorsements or confirmed eligibility.
metadata.funding_caution: Packages, gross salaries and tuition waivers are not interchangeable. No award, place, appointment or partnership secured.
metadata.deadline_policy: Blank dates mean no applicable current deadline verified. Recurring or historical dates are text, not confirmed future calls.

routes.programme: PhD in Design, Technology and Society / GenEnv
routes.route_type: Architecture-school doctorate with funded lab recruitment
routes.deadline_timezone: Not specified in retrieved programme deadline
routes.secondary_deadlines: Lab reviews start late October 2026; transcripts 2027-01-15; references 2027-01-31.
routes.recruitment_evidence: GenEnv recruits for September 2027. Programme applications opened 1 October 2026.
routes.funding_evidence: Four-year lab support; UBC's full-time Vancouver PhD minimum is CAD 40,000/year for the first four years from September 2026. Award payments go to tuition/fees before the balance is paid.
routes.eligibility_caveats: A relevant master's and research potential are required. Lab openness to HCI and interaction design does not override formal degree or English requirements.
routes.fit_assessment: Highest actionable bridge from interaction design into an architecture-school doctorate: spatial handoff and bounded human authority, not a generic agent tool.
routes.next_action: Prepare a concise fit statement, CV, work samples and repo link for user review; clarify degree eligibility and the fee/stipend split.
routes.unknowns: Lab selection, admission, capacity and net funding unconfirmed.

routes.programme: Architecture / Computational Design, Situated Computation + Design Lab
routes.secondary_deadlines: Lab says formal school application January 2027; school page gives January 10 without an intake year. Confirm exact cycle/date.
routes.recruitment_evidence: Noel's lab advertises a Fall 2027 PhD call with an earlier lab expression-of-interest deadline.
routes.funding_evidence: Call specifies tuition, health insurance and a twelve-month stipend, without a published amount.
routes.eligibility_caveats: Design, HCI and humanities backgrounds are welcomed; formal PhD degree equivalence still needs confirmation.
routes.fit_assessment: Strong critical and ethnographic computation route for studying delegated authority as embodied civic practice.
routes.next_action: Prepare the one-page proposal, CV and portfolio for review before the lab deadline; confirm the formal programme and offer terms.
routes.unknowns: Selection, capacity, exact school deadline, stipend amount and full funding duration unconfirmed. No form submitted.

routes.institution: Singapore University of Technology and Design
routes.programme: PhD in Architecture and Sustainable Design
routes.deadline_timezone: Not specified on retrieved intake page
routes.recruitment_evidence: Official PhD listing gives 30 October 2026 for the January 2027 intake and includes ASD.
routes.funding_evidence: All-nationality fellowships cover applicable tuition for up to four years. International monthly stipends effective January 2026: SGD 3,100 PhD Fellowship; SGD 4,300 President's Graduate Fellowship.
routes.eligibility_caveats: Awards are competitive. Confirm ASD admission requirements, supervisory fit and whether this start is feasible.
routes.fit_assessment: Potential Asia-Pacific computational/spatial anchor, conditional on topic and timing fit.
routes.next_action: Ask Joyce and the programme office about MA equivalence, capacity and fellowship requirements before deciding between January and a later cycle.
routes.unknowns: No supervisor acceptance or funded place confirmed.

routes.institution: University of Hong Kong / Research Grants Council
routes.programme: Architecture PhD with Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme
routes.route_type: Two-stage competitive fellowship and university admission
routes.secondary_deadlines: HKU full application by 2026-12-01 23:59 Asia/Hong_Kong, after obtaining the RGC reference number.
routes.recruitment_evidence: RGC and HKU publish a 2027/28 exercise with distinct initial and full submissions.
routes.funding_evidence: HKU lists HKD 28,700/month and HKD 14,400/year research/conference travel for up to three years, plus Presidential scholarship support for HKPFS holders.
routes.eligibility_caveats: Internationally open scheme; architecture-specific degree and English requirements remain separate. Confirm support for the full doctorate.
routes.fit_assessment: Crolla is a computational-design connection; the civic-access strand needs complementary spatial/social methods.
routes.next_action: Verify degree admissibility and supervisor interest, then prepare the two submissions separately.
routes.unknowns: Admission, nomination, fellowship, fees and later-year funding unconfirmed.

routes.route_type: Programme admission with competitive funding consideration
routes.secondary_deadlines: Final course deadline 2027-05-13 if places remain, not the funding deadline.
routes.recruitment_evidence: Architecture publishes the first deadline and recommends discussing fit with an established University Teaching Officer.
routes.funding_evidence: Timely applicants are considered for funding. The course finance page advertises no specific course award; selection is separate.
routes.eligibility_caveats: Confirm that the MA is a relevant research degree and that grades meet equivalence requirements. Later admission is not a funding plan.
routes.fit_assessment: Bardhan may anchor equitable environmental conditions, complemented by interaction-design methods.
routes.next_action: Prepare a short architectural proposal, writing sample and CV; identify applicable awards before the first deadline.
routes.unknowns: Supervisor availability, admission eligibility and funding unconfirmed.

routes.programme: Research Excellence Scholarship with an eligible MPhil/PhD
routes.secondary_deadlines: Do not reuse 9 January 2026 from the prior round.
routes.recruitment_evidence: Official page says 2026/27 is closed and offers notification when 2027/28 opens.
routes.funding_evidence: Prior round was fully funded and internationally open; its terms do not establish a new-round award.
routes.eligibility_caveats: Departmental admission and scholarship rules both apply. Do not transfer home-only eligibility from other Bartlett schemes.
routes.fit_assessment: Retains a funding pathway for strong UCL spatial-interaction fit without treating a historical award as open.
routes.next_action: Prepare supervisor-fit material and recheck the official scholarship and department pages when the call appears.
routes.unknowns: Opening, terms, dates, departmental nomination and capacity unconfirmed.

routes.status: Published deadline; matching project catalogue pending
routes.secondary_deadlines: Catalogue expected 2026-10-26. UCL encourages applications/references by 2026-12-16 because of closure-period support limits.
routes.recruitment_evidence: Official 2027/28 catalogue is forthcoming; no matching architecture project verified yet.
routes.funding_evidence: Four-year studentships cover fees, including the international/home difference for international awardees. International recruitment is capped.
routes.eligibility_caveats: Requires a matching eligible advertised project and departmental entry qualifications; not unrestricted support for any Bartlett proposal.
routes.fit_assessment: Conditional built-environment or embodied-interaction opportunity only.
routes.next_action: Check the published catalogue for an actual project match before preparing an application.
routes.unknowns: Applicable project, supervisor, award and capacity unconfirmed.

routes.programme: Architecture and Sciences of the City (EDAR)
routes.route_type: Programme admission plus funded chair/employment match
routes.status: Recurring programme deadlines; funded match unverified
routes.secondary_deadlines: January 15, 2027 is the next calendar occurrence, not a verified dated funded call.
routes.recruitment_evidence: EDAR publishes three annual admission dates; final acceptance depends on topic, director and funding.
routes.funding_evidence: Doctoral-assistant starting salary is CHF 55,225 gross/year from January 2026. Admission can occur without a funded position.
routes.eligibility_caveats: Salary applies to an actual appointment, not automatically to all admitted candidates.
routes.fit_assessment: ALICE may support collective spatial making and embodied presence if the chair and financial route fit.
routes.next_action: Ask Dietz/EDAR about funded recruitment or acceptable external funding before relying on a programme date.
routes.unknowns: Matching lab position, degree equivalence, funded appointment and capacity unconfirmed.

routes.route_type: Professor selection and normally linked employment
routes.status: Programme available; matching funded vacancy unverified
routes.recruitment_evidence: D-ARCH directs candidates to the ETH job portal.
routes.funding_evidence: ETH says a doctorate is predominantly linked to employment; registration and departmental approval precede an employment contract.
routes.eligibility_caveats: Recognized degree, academic admission and funded appointment are distinct requirements.
routes.fit_assessment: Digital Building Technologies may support physical prototyping; fabrication alone is not the social-governance anchor.
routes.next_action: Check chair recruitment and ask how the specific spatial experiment would be funded and evaluated.
routes.unknowns: No matching open job, salary offer or capacity verified.

routes.route_type: Doctoral employment or approved external-employer funding
routes.status: Matching architecture vacancy not found in retrieved listings
routes.deadline_stage: No matching open doctoral job established
routes.recruitment_evidence: The retrieved current board did not establish a fitting architecture PhD; its architecture/built-environment role was an associate professorship.
routes.funding_evidence: Architecture doctoral study requires at least four years of guaranteed funding, through the institution or an external employer.
routes.eligibility_caveats: An architecture master's or relevant equivalent is assessed for the position. General interest does not create a funded vacancy.
routes.fit_assessment: Koch remains a strong spatial/social-use anchor, with funding feasibility currently unresolved.
routes.next_action: Discuss fit and qualifications, then identify a real vacancy or approved employer-financed route.
routes.unknowns: Finding is limited to retrieved listings on the check date, not all possible future or unpublished opportunities.

routes.programme: Architecture and the Built Environment / funded PhD vacancies
routes.status: Current faculty vacancies; delegated-presence match unverified
routes.recruitment_evidence: Current listings include natural building skins and indoor thermal variation; neither is a verified match for this proposal.
routes.funding_evidence: Funding must be established through a specific position or approved arrangement; no funded Bier/Havik position for this topic established.
routes.eligibility_caveats: Requirements and dates are vacancy-specific. Do not transfer another project's terms to Robotic Building.
routes.fit_assessment: Bier and qualitative architectural methods could form a useful team, with employment still unresolved.
routes.next_action: Ask what current or forthcoming funded project could actually accommodate this question.
routes.unknowns: Topic fit, degree equivalence, faculty capacity and funded offer unconfirmed.

routes.route_type: Annual doctoral admission with position-specific support
routes.deadline_stage: Next intake opens at beginning of 2027
routes.secondary_deadlines: Prior 31 March 2026 date and position counts are historical, not new-round terms.
routes.recruitment_evidence: EKA explicitly says 2026/27 is closed and 2027/28 opens at the beginning of 2027.
routes.funding_evidence: Prior call distinguished junior-researcher employment, scholarship and unsupported places. New-round funded places are not verified.
routes.eligibility_caveats: Relevant master's-level access and degree recognition need next-call confirmation.
routes.fit_assessment: Potential local architectural and governance anchor if a particular supported place fits.
routes.next_action: Prepare the spatial contribution and supervisory discussion; recheck the new call before relying on funding.
routes.unknowns: Dates, position numbers, terms, capacity and funding unconfirmed.

routes.recruitment_evidence: Official timeline lists Fall 2027 as TBA.

routes.eligibility_caveats: Confirm the FACT-related department and degree pathway; relevant architectural work may be housed in engineering.

routes.programme: IGP(A), architecture-related integrated master's and doctorate
routes.route_type: Integrated M+D admission with possible MEXT nomination
routes.status: Open integrated route; not direct doctoral entry
routes.recruitment_evidence: Official Fall 2027 IGP(A) includes architecture-related programmes and prior supervisor consent.
routes.funding_evidence: Eligible outstanding applicants may receive limited MEXT nomination; not guaranteed.
routes.eligibility_caveats: Guide requires master's enrolment even for applicants already holding a master's. Scholarship conditions are additional; not direct PhD entry.
routes.fit_assessment: Potential Japan connection, but the extra master's could be a material mismatch. General programme listing does not establish Tsukamoto participation.
routes.next_action: Check participating supervisor, lab process and degree route before preparing application materials.
routes.unknowns: Supervisor participation, scholarship eligibility, selection and capacity unconfirmed.

routes.route_type: Restricted projects or verified external sponsorship
routes.priority: Do not prioritize without genuine fit
routes.deadline_stage: Check dates only if project and funding fit
routes.recruitment_evidence: Funded architecture intake is limited to housing/epidemiology and responsive material/structure projects. The latter NSF-linked route is limited to US citizens, nationals and permanent residents.
routes.funding_evidence: External support must cover four years of tuition, fees, health insurance and minimum stipend. Penn does not accept self-pay PhD students.
routes.eligibility_caveats: Current delegated-presence proposal is not an evident project match.
routes.fit_assessment: Retain Smith for research discussion, not as evidence of funded admission for an independent topic.
routes.next_action: Pursue only with a genuinely matching listed project or qualifying third-party sponsorship.
routes.unknowns: No fitting project, sponsorship, eligibility, capacity or admission established.

routes.institution: ANRT / employer and French doctoral laboratory
routes.status: Mechanism available; employer and project not agreed
routes.priority: Explore with willing employer and lab
routes.recruitment_evidence: ANRT publishes year-round review. Tixier's lab records a historical CIFRE doctorate, not a present vacancy.
routes.funding_evidence: ANRT's 2026 scheme sets hiring salary at least EUR 27,600 gross/year; its subsidy goes to the employer, not automatically to the student.
routes.eligibility_caveats: Needs a qualifying employer, laboratory, doctoral admission and approval. Nationality openness is not personal or project eligibility.
routes.fit_assessment: A possible structure for architecture plus a real building-access partner. Tixier/company pairing is an inference, not an existing partnership.
routes.next_action: Establish mutual interest and a suitable employer site, then verify ANRT eligibility and publication/IP terms.
routes.unknowns: No employer, lab commitment, qualifying contract or project approval. Schneider is a connector hypothesis, not a sponsor.
